legend: You have a large electronic screen which can display up to 1000000007$$$1000000007$$$ decimal digits. each place for a digit consists of 7$$$7$$$ segments which can be turned on and off to compose different digits. The following picture describes how you can display all 10 decimal digits:

As you can see, different digits may require different numbers of segments to be turned on. For example, if you want to display 1$$$1$$$, you have to turn on 2$$$2$$$ segments of the screen, and if you want to display 8$$$8$$$, all 7$$$7$$$ segments of someplace to display a digit should be turned on.

Your task is to find the minimum number you can show on display by turning exactly N$$$N$$$ segments on. You can't have leading zeroes in the number, that means the first digit of your number can be 0$$$0$$$ if and only if the total number you're showing is 0$$$0$$$.
input: The first line contains one integer t(1≤t≤104)$$$t (1 \leq t \leq 10^4)$$$ — the number of test cases in the input.

Then the test cases follow, each of them is represented by a separate line containing one integer n(2≤n≤106)$$$n (2 \leq n \leq 10^6)$$$ — the number of segments that should be turned on in the corresponding test case.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n$$$n$$$ over all test cases in the input does not exceed 106$$$10^6$$$.
output: For each test case, print the smallest integer that can be displayed by turning on exactly n$$$n$$$ segments of the screen without leading zeores. Note that the answer may not fit in the standard 32$$$32$$$-bit or 64$$$64$$$-bit integral data type.

legend.ai: 你有一块大型电子屏幕，最多可以显示 1000000007$$$1000000007$$$ 个十进制数字。每个数字的位置由 7$$$7$$$ 个可以打开或关闭的线段组成，这些线段可以组合出不同的数字。下图展示了如何显示全部 10 个十进制数字：
如你所见，不同的数字可能需要点亮不同数量的线段。例如，如果你想显示 1$$$1$$$，就必须点亮屏幕上的 2$$$2$$$ 个线段；而如果你想显示 8$$$8$$$，用于显示某个数字的全部 7$$$7$$$ 个线段都必须被点亮。
你的任务是通过恰好点亮 N$$$N$$$ 个线段，求出你能在显示屏上显示的最小数字。数字不能有前导零，也就是说，当且仅当你显示的总数为 0$$$0$$$ 时，数字的第一位才可以是 0$$$0$$$。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 t(1≤t≤104)$$$t (1 \leq t \leq 10^4)$$$——输入中的测试用例数量。
随后给出各个测试用例，每个测试用例占一行，包含一个整数 n(2≤n≤106)$$$n (2 \leq n \leq 10^6)$$$——相应测试用例中应点亮的数码管段数。
保证输入中所有测试用例的 n$$$n$$$ 之和不超过 106$$$10^6$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出在不含前导零的情况下，点亮显示屏上恰好 n$$$n$$$ 段所能显示的最小整数。注意，答案可能无法适用于标准的 32$$$32$$$ 位或 64$$$64$$$ 位整数数据类型。
